author: Crackdaddy
quote: $80 for the base game that's full of bugs and boring cutscenes and dialogue. the first chapter is a sloppy boring mess. the reviews are right calling this a dating/cuck simulator. it's obvious it's another western gaming studio with a twisted agenda; besides that, the main characters are bland/boring and Lucia is just annoying (who is probably the real main character.) the worst part of it all is you can't even do whatever you want in the game. it's not like all the other GTA when you can go on a rampage, this game restricts you like the cuck you are in this game.  ive played all the GTA's growing up and this is not GTA.
